specification.name: EduGate ScholarLink
specification.description:
EduGate ScholarLink is an entry-level API Gateway tailored for educational platforms that need to consolidate multiple micro-services—such as course catalogs, assessment engines, student profiles, and analytics—behind a single, well-governed entry point. Although classified as an easy project, it brings real-world gateway concerns (versioning, request validation, GraphQL schema stitching, error handling, monitoring, and live API documentation) into a compact, component-based codebase written in C. 

The project’s educational twist lies in its domain-specific façade: every route, policy, and metric is anchored in learning concepts. For example, request throttling is expressed in *“requests per enrolled student”*, version tags follow the curriculum year (e.g., v2024_Spring), and its monitoring dashboard labels endpoints by pedagogic objectives (e.g., /v1/quiz → “Formative Assessment”). By decomposing gateway concerns into pluggable components (router, validator, schema registry, metrics reporter, doc generator), students and instructors can mix-and-match or hot-swap modules to demonstrate best practices in modular design without drowning in complexity.

Ultimately, EduGate ScholarLink serves as a hands-on springboard for learners who want to explore microservices, REST, and GraphQL in a controlled academic context while appreciating how a clean component boundary accelerates maintenance, experimentation, and knowledge transfer.
dependencies: cJSON (lightweight JSON parsing & serialization for validation and REST payloads)
libgraphqlparser or cgql (GraphQL parsing and schema validation)
OpenAPI-C or libswagger (generates live API documentation)
jansson or equivalent optional JSON schema validator
